name: Systems Theory
description: Behaviour emerges from interactions within interconnected systems rather than isolated parts.

name: Game Theory
description: Strategic interaction where outcomes depend on the choices of multiple agents.

name: Behavioural Economics
description: Human decision-making is shaped by cognitive biases and heuristics under constraint.

name: Complexity Theory
description: Small changes in systems can produce disproportionate and unpredictable effects.

name: Diffusion of Innovation
description: Ideas and behaviours spread through populations in patterned adoption curves.

name: Network Effects
description: The value of a system increases as more participants engage with it.

name: Activity Theory
description: Human activity is shaped by tools, goals, and social context interacting as a system.
